authorization: User: Then train it. Offline training and Q4 testing only; no deployment.
schedule: linear warmup, cosine decay; first update uses zero learning rate
objective: restricted-slot cross entropy + Brier, weight 1; task/head/label balanced weights N/(K*n)
precision: FP32 master weights and answer readout; BF16 autocast decoder; no TF32
backend: eager attention; PyTorch reference gated-delta rule; gradient checkpointing, non-reentrant
optimizer: AdamW; weight decay 0; foreach=False; gradient clipping norm 1
batch: one complete native input per microbatch; actual-batch-size accumulation divisor, including short batches
option_order: alternate native A/B option order by (epoch + sorted row index) modulo 2; inference uses original order
augmentation: only declared option-order permutation; no state reserialization augmentation, cropping, splitting or synthetic rows
tiny_gate: all eight targets learned, exact optimizer membership, all native gradients finite/nonzero and decoder/slot witnesses changed; reset to original checkpoint before full fit
selection: one fixed seed and fixed final epoch; no seed/epoch/threshold selection or full matrix
evaluation: 37 DEV + 93 archive diagnostics, same frozen full inputs for baseline and trained Q4, final checkpoint only; not fresh or human gold
size_exception: experiment only; production weight limit unchanged
scope: offline experiment, no deployment; immutable active contract binds all private sources
